data.name: Sharad
data.gender_notes: Sharad is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit śarad, 'autumn'. Its root is Sanskrit śarad (शरद्). A classical Sanskrit name for autumn. Sharad is a Sanskrit name meaning “Autumn; (also) a year”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharad expresses “Autumn; (also) a year”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharad total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
